inspectionMethod: Native source frames, independent before/contact/after review and dark/light output contacts. Browser verification is recorded separately.

species.name: Wormaren
species.releaseEvidence: Frame35 reaches the first clear downward head strike; frame34 is still descending.
species.reactionEvidence: Frame29 first shows the torso contact flash and contraction.
species.scaleReference: Initial opaque body; all native motion and effects retained in canvas padding.

species.name: Clastoom
species.releaseEvidence: Frame46 first releases the orange ring from the fist.
species.reactionEvidence: Frame18 first closes the eyes and contracts the body, before the flash at19.
species.scaleReference: Initial opaque body; all native motion and effects retained in canvas padding.

species.name: Clastoom
species.releaseEvidence: Frame43 first places the hand on the ground with the initial impact splash.
species.reactionEvidence: Frame38 first closes the eyes and recoils; the later flash is at42.
species.scaleReference: Initial opaque body; all native motion and effects retained in canvas padding.

species.name: Clastoom
species.releaseEvidence: Native frame54 holds the raised charged palm. Frame55 begins the decisive forward/downward arm swing and orange flame sweep, growing across56-58 before the ground impact59.
species.reactionEvidence: Native frame15 retains the normal open-eye face. Frame16 first narrows the eyes in the initial wince; the head compresses further17-22 before the larger backward body recoil23. Use this early cue to avoid pre-impact recoil while waiting.
species.scaleReference: Initial opaque body; all native motion and effects retained in canvas padding.

species.name: Colussand
species.releaseEvidence: Native frame35 retains the raised hands at the end of the windup. Frame36 first drives the hands downward with visible golden sand speed trails; the ground splash follows40-41.
species.reactionEvidence: Native frame12 is neutral. Frame13 first shows the white/golden contact star on the chest, growing14-18 before the head/body recoil19.
species.scaleReference: Initial opaque body; all native motion and effects retained in canvas padding.

species.name: Sparkly
species.releaseEvidence: Native frame49 retains the held chest charge. Frame50 first expands the chest burst past the arms; the emitted white/cyan sphere appears51 and expands52-55.
species.reactionEvidence: Native frame29 retains only the intrinsic round chest light. Frame30 first expands it into a distinct white contact star; the sharper flash and physical recoil follow31-34.
species.scaleReference: Initial opaque body; all native motion and effects retained in canvas padding.

species.name: Grimbolt
species.releaseEvidence: Native frame51 holds the forward paws with no emitted slash. Frame52 first emits the cyan paw slash, growing53 and joined by golden lightning54.
species.reactionEvidence: Native frame26 has normal open blue eyes and no contact star. Frame27 first closes the eyes and shows the yellow/white chest impact; the flash grows28-30.
species.scaleReference: Initial opaque body; all native motion and effects retained in canvas padding.
